patent_id.description: Unique canonical patent application number issued by the Indian Patent Office (e.g., '10/DEL/2010', '1005/MUMNP/2007').

publication_number.description: InPASS gazette journal publication issue identifier (e.g., '01/2016').

publication_date.description: Date on which the granted patent was published in the official patent journal.

filing_date.description: Date of formal patent application filing with the Indian Patent Office.

date_updated.description: Last database update timestamp recorded in InPASS.

pendency_days.description: Elapsed duration in days between application filing and gazette publication (grant notification).

title.description: Cleaned invention title with normalized Unicode, outer quotes stripped, and scientific symbols preserved.

title_normalized.description: Lowercase normalized title optimized for search tokenization and keyword matching.

field_of_invention.description: Standardized technology classification assigned by IPO (e.g., CHEMISTRY, MECHANICAL, ELECTRONICS, or UNCATEGORIZED).

field_imputed.description: Indicator flag specifying if field_of_invention was missing in source and assigned 'UNCATEGORIZED'.

ipo_location.description: Indian Patent Office branch jurisdiction: Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, or Mumbai.

ipo_code.description: Standard 3-letter branch code abbreviation: DEL, CHE, KOL, or MUM.

application_type.description: Title-cased official application procedure description (e.g. 'Pct National Phase Application').

application_category.description: High-level procedure category: 'PCT National Phase', 'Ordinary', 'Convention', 'Divisional', or 'Patent of Addition'.

no_of_pages.description: Exact number of pages in patent specification. Retains null if missing.

no_of_claims.description: Exact number of granted claims. Retains null if missing.

no_of_pages_imputed.description: ML feature with missing page counts imputed using technology field median.

no_of_claims_imputed.description: ML feature with missing claim counts imputed using technology field median.

claims_range.description: Binned claim scope category: '1-5 claims', '6-15 claims', '16-30 claims', '30+ claims', or 'Unknown'.

source_file.description: Name of the raw InPASS CSV file from which the patent record originated.

source_url.description: Official verification URL for IPO public search portal.

search_text.description: Unified semantic representation combining title, field, jurisdiction, type, and timeline for hybrid retrieval.
